skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to calculate statistical indices for trade and tourism.
Skill in collecting data for trade and tourism statistics.
Understanding and application of statistical analysis methods in trade and tourism.
Ability to forecast key indicators in trade and tourism using statistical methods.
Ability to critically think about issues in trade and tourism.
Capacity to conduct independent research on trade and tourism topics.
Ability to collaborate effectively in group projects related to trade and tourism.
Proficiency in using statistical software for data analysis in trade and tourism.
